page.overview:
Who is Dom Antyll?

Dom Antyll was one of the best starship technicians in all of Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. He owned Docking Bay 92, which he converted for use in starship repairs. His prices were high, and he tended to raise the price for anyone who questioned his ability, but his work was excellent.

Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope, Second Edition
